affected_locations: Hess Port Reading Refinery, Port Reading, New Jersey
key_impacts: Storm surge flooding exceeded New York City’s 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak.
Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway refineries were shut, cutting 26.3% of regional refining capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate due to power outages.
Three healthcare facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
evidence_snippets: On October 29, Sandy’s storm surge flooded New York City, exceeding 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
As of November 6, Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway refineries were shut, and three NYC healthcare facilities evacuated patients.
